groups.title: House Stark
groups.def: Born a Stark, or married the head of House Stark, during the show. Wards, servants, and allies like Theon, Meera, and Hodor don't count.

groups.title: House Lannister
groups.def: Born a Lannister, including Cersei and Jaime's three children, who are secretly Lannisters by blood despite being publicly styled Baratheon.

groups.title: House Baratheon
groups.def: Born a Baratheon, styled a Baratheon as one of Robert's children, or married the reigning Baratheon king.

groups.title: House Targaryen
groups.def: Born a Targaryen, including Jon Snow, who is secretly Rhaegar and Lyanna Stark's trueborn son.

groups.title: Dornish
groups.def: Born in Dorne: House Martell plus Oberyn's paramour Ellaria Sand (Myrcella only lived there).

groups.title: The Small Council
groups.def: Sat on the Small Council, the king or queen's ruling cabinet, at some point in the show.

groups.title: Kingsguard
groups.def: Served in the Kingsguard (or Queensguard) at some point, even briefly or for a different monarch. The Hound is sworn in but deserts, and Podrick is only named at the very end.

groups.title: Night's Watch
groups.def: Took the black and served at the Wall as a member of the Night's Watch.

groups.title: Free Folk
groups.def: A wildling living beyond the Wall (Free Folk) who becomes a named character.

groups.title: Direwolves' owners
groups.def: The six Stark children who each found and raised one of the direwolf pups in Season 1.

groups.title: In House Lannister's service
groups.def: Worked for House Lannister by choice at some point without being born or married into the family (not an unwilling hostage like Sansa).

groups.title: Sat on the Iron Throne
groups.def: Ruled as king or queen from the Iron Throne itself. Cersei was the last monarch ever to sit on it.

groups.title: Killed at a wedding feast
groups.def: Killed during their own or someone else's wedding feast: the Red Wedding or the Purple Wedding.

groups.title: Burned alive
groups.def: Burned to death on screen: Shireen on Stannis's pyre, the other three by Drogon's dragonfire.

groups.title: Hand of the King or Queen
groups.def: Formally held the title Hand of the King or Hand of the Queen at some point in the show.
